name: A Necromantic Connection
source:
Your feet led you toward him like a moth to the pyre.

You were so curious. So curious.

A curious cat following the footsteps of a wolf.

[From [url=https://lyxil.itch.io/a-necromantic-connection]Itch.io[/url]]
